envelope.text: {{p1}} has sent you an invitation to a celebration.

album.text: Send old memories now, and photos from the celebration on the day. Everything goes into the album.

gallery.statusManual: The gallery opens when the host opens it.

upload.disabledText: The host has turned off photo uploads through this link for now.
upload.sentText: You sent {{photos}}. {{p1}} will see them right away, and the best ones go into the album.
upload.kindMemoriesText: Old photos with the guest of honour: trips, parties, childhood. They go into the “Memories” chapter.
upload.message: Message for the guest of honour (shown with the photos in the album)
upload.privacy: Only the host sees the photos until they approve them.

rsvp.askNotify: Would you like us to let you know when the celebration photos are ready?
